source_text: The European Space Agency has confirmed that its Euclid telescope has sent back its first full-colour images of the cosmos. Euclid launched in July 2023 on a six-year mission to create the largest ever 3D map of the universe. Scientists hope the mission will shed light on dark matter and dark energy, which together make up 95 percent of the known cosmos but remain largely undetected.
reference_summary: The Euclid telescope has captured its first full-colour cosmic images to help map dark matter and dark energy.

source_text: Scientists at the University of Cambridge have demonstrated a new lithium-oxygen battery design with energy density approaching theoretical limits. The prototype achieved over 2000 charge cycles in laboratory tests with minimal degradation. While commercially viable consumer versions remain several years away, the breakthrough addresses major thermal stability and recharge efficiency bottlenecks.
reference_summary: Cambridge researchers have developed an experimental lithium-oxygen battery showing high capacity and improved longevity.

source_text: Global climate authorities reported that average ocean temperatures in March broke all historical instrumental records. Tropical Pacific regions observed an accelerated rise in surface temperature, impacting coral reef ecosystems across the Southern Hemisphere. Marine biologists warned that sustained elevated temperatures could trigger widespread coral bleaching events unless thermal stress subsides.
reference_summary: Record ocean surface temperatures observed in March are raising severe concerns regarding global coral bleaching.

source_text: The Reserve Bank of India has maintained its key repo rate at 6.5 percent following its bi-monthly monetary policy committee meeting. Governor Shaktikanta Das announced that while retail inflation had moderated toward the target band, geopolitical uncertainties and volatile food prices warranted continued vigilance. Financial markets responded with modest gains across banking equities.
reference_summary: The RBI has kept its benchmark repo rate unchanged at 6.5 percent while keeping a close eye on food inflation.

metadata.title: RBI Keeps Benchmark Repo Rate Unchanged

source_text: Archaeologists in southern Greece have uncovered a Mycenaean palace complex dating back to the fourteenth century BCE. Excavations revealed extensive clay tablets inscribed with Linear B script detailing administrative inventories, agricultural yields, and ceremonial offerings. Historians describe the finding as one of the most significant Bronze Age discoveries in recent decades.
reference_summary: Archaeologists in Greece have unearthed a fourteenth-century BCE Mycenaean palace containing Linear B inscriptions.
